title: Haven Upholstered Headboard – Handmade Fabric Headboard
descriptionHtml:
The Haven Upholstered Headboard is for anyone who wants a calm, inviting bedroom. Its clean, softly padded design suits contemporary and classic rooms, and it is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Clean, softly padded design
  • Soft-touch fabric for comfort when you sit up to read or relax
  • Wall-mounted or attached to a divan base
  • Five UK sizes, with made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a solid hardwood frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Can I fit the Haven headboard to a divan base?

Yes. It can be wall-mounted or attached to a divan base.

Is it made to measure?

Made-to-measure options are available on request. Call 07417 439197 or email us to discuss.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
